data.content_ref: inline:The target asserts an abstraction relation (expert variable-weighting abstracts the additive panel process), but the refutation clause is non-substantive: it only restates the endpoints—'objectively verifiable' outcome becomes a boolean conjunction, so weighting yields no marginal utility—without naming the relation kind (e.g., reduction or abstraction) that connects weighting to that outcome. Per the condition, a summary of endpoints is not a relation, so it omits the required substantive 'refuted if' dependency.
